observations: Photo 0 shows a white and black console with a black stripe across the top, placed on a wooden surface. The console has a small logo on the top right corner, resembling the PlayStation logo.
Photo 1 shows the same console in front of a TV displaying a soccer game. The console is on a wooden cabinet with a clock and cables visible. The console appears to be in a home setting.
The console has a glossy finish with visible reflections and minor smudges. No visible damage to the casing.
No power cord, HDMI cable, or other accessories are shown in the photos.
The seller claims it is 'Barely Used' and 'Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working. Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.'

claims.evidence: Photos show minor smudges and reflections, but no clear signs of heavy use. No serial number or model label visible to confirm condition. The claim cannot be verified from the photos alone.

claims.claim: Neatly used, never opened or repaired, no overheating, all ports working. Comes with the original pads and the UK receipt.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Console may not be functional or may have internal damage
risks.proof: Video of the console powering on, booting into the system, and playing a game.

risks.risk: Missing accessories (power cable, HDMI cable, controller, etc.)
risks.proof: Photo showing all included accessories laid out next to the console.

risks.risk: Console may be stolen or have a blacklisted serial number
risks.proof: Photo of the serial number sticker on the back of the console.
risks.if_unproven: priced with risk of legal issues

proof_requests: Photo of the back of the console showing the serial number sticker.
Video of the console powering on and booting into the system.
Photo showing all included accessories (power cable, HDMI cable, controller, etc.).
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
